message:
The other day, we found ourselves in a flurry of excitement—our family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. 🏡 We were all sharing our go-bag ideas, and it turned out we each had different essentials we thought were must-haves. One cousin swore by a portable charger, while another insisted on a deck of cards for downtime. As we tossed around suggestions, it struck me how easy it is to overlook the basics when we’re caught up in daily life. 

But in those moments of collective brainstorming, we not only shared practical tips but also laughter and a sense of togetherness. It reminded us that being prepared doesn’t have to feel heavy; sometimes, it’s just about keeping the conversation going. What’s one thing you would add to our family go-bag? 🤔
